open_rows.question: Every remaining field and nonsplit determinant
open_rows.finding_ids_or_current_gate: Every split class-number-one sixfold, every Eisenstein determinant and Gaussian signed determinant class3 has a numerical detector bound. Other nonsplit determinants remain open. Curve sources require actual original-field descent and period rank9. Original reflection-free coefficient degree>=15; inducing dimensions1/2/3 and non-Eisenstein7 are excluded. The remaining inducing4/5/6/8 exceptional profiles are exactly D-BI11/12,D-R5,D-BI16,HD-E8IF1; the explicit paired G33 Nielsen component is excluded, other components/descent remain. D-BI13/14/14a/15 impose the stated ramification, degree and nonnormality bounds. For every primitive factorwise tensor-indecomposable inducing degree>=5, D-BI19 forces an irreducible transitive quasisimple central-product core. D-BI18/20 excludes extraspecial cores and Lie fieldsq>=29 in degree>=10, with stronger ESD bounds. All sporadic, all A1, all Suzuki/Ree/Tits, all transitive linear-Weil SL_n(q) (n>=3), and all G2(q>=3)/3D4(q>=2) cores are excluded (D-SPOR,D-BI21/22/23,D-G2T01--03); the last result permits mixed factors. Odd symplectic Weil cores reduce to singleSp4(3)degree4/5; D-SPW04 gives the same nonsplit non-Eisenstein endpoint for all its representations. D-BI24 reduces all transitive ordinary unitary-Weil cores to single PSU4(2) degree5/6, with only5 in the stated nonsplit scope. D-ESC01--03 excludes all even-characteristic Sp4/Sp6 cores in the main problem, allowing mixed ranks/fields for q>=4 and using BI17 only for the transitive Sp6(2) degree7 endpoint. Other small-field higher-rank Lie cores remain. All spin2.An,n>=8, and all ordinaryAn,8<=n<=14, are excluded (HD-SPIN02,HD-ALT02,D-AST). HD-ALT03 forces all remaining ordinary An,n>=15 factors to extend to real Specht modules, so the inducing image is ESD. HD-ALT04/05 further force every transitive factor label to have a row/column>6n/7; the final tail-content bound gives e<=144 against unsplit factor degree>=250 in the excluded annulus. The all-degree scalar single-factor standard,exterior-square andunordered-pair cases remain excluded; long-shape tensor cases and residualA7/covers remain. These are necessary supplier restrictions, not existence results. The non-curve alternative is Q5i.

open_rows.question: Can a genuine balanced-RM split-eightfold perfect-complex seed be constructed?
open_rows.finding_ids_or_current_gate: No genuine balanced-RM weakly equivariant semiregular eightfold seed has been constructed. SF-E801--E810 excludes the stated rational-block, integrality and CI-secants; the actual semiregular coneSF-E814 has two-pure character and does not meet this gate. SF-E811--E813 excludes stable/polystable locally free objects and semistable bundles with locally free stable factors. SF-E818 extends this to torsion-free objects with such locally free hulls. SF-E817 excludes all nonzero point defects with a locally free hull, without stability/simplicity. SF-E819/E819R includes nonpure coherent objects: locally free hull with finite kernel/cokernel requires equal lengths at each point, and every nontrivial point must have a nonreduced defect module. The actual rank36 nonpure balanced construction fails this test. SF-E820 excludes all nontrivial modifications with both modules free over a common curvilinear Artinian quotient, of any length; actual rank32 equal-length nonreduced balanced extensions are constructed and excluded. Locally free objects with zero defect require the separate stability exclusions. SF-E815/R excludes the stated simple positive-aggregate projectively-flat models; the seven-class model requiresEndG>=63. SF-E816/a/b/c excludes ordinary-gluable primitive projectively-flat models in any two cohomology degrees, including overlaps/arbitrary gaps, and arbitrary amplitude with globally disjoint classes. SF-E821/E821a excludes every actual local surface summand with a positive squared-eigenpolarization pairing, including the constructed rank16 balanced cones and any torsion-free quotient. SF-E822 excludes equal-rank/equal-degree vector-bundle torsion/defect repairs on smooth integral surfaces of class k²theta², including genuinely coupled rank32 examples and every same-entire-character repair of a balanced hull. Remaining: unstable bundles, singular stable factors/reflexive hulls, nonreduced equal-length point modifications outside the common-curvilinear-free case, positive-dimensional torsion/defects outsideE818/E821/E822 (including unequal-degree, other support classes, nonreduced/singular support or broader derived couplings), overlapping classes in at least3cohomology degrees, twisted or sufficiently nonsimple objects, and broader class spaces. The pure counterexampleE816d does not supply a balanced seed.
